- **car2** makes two round trips between Kalika hospital and Belkot school, bringing back all 5 children. Total: 32 + 32 = 64 minutes. A second trip (32) costs less than deferring a child (60).
- **Deferred:**
  - 1 elderly person at Thakre temple (penalty 50). A round trip there would cost 82 minutes of driving.
  - 1 adult at Syaphru village (penalty 20). One more trip would cost at least 36 minutes.
